purpose: Prevent recurrence of the P03 failures before any later-page production starts.

styleAnchors.rule: These are V30 publication-family rendering anchors only, never layout templates. Later pages must keep their own Visual Master composition while inheriting high saturation, dark outline, bright keyline, controlled shadow, printed sticker/cutout feel, clean paper, and pop tropical/travel rendering.

requiredBeforeAnyPartGeneration: direct review of actual page Visual Master

representativeEcologyRule.rule: After page-specific review, choose exactly one representative ecology and generate/install only that ecology first. Compare it directly against P01/P02/P03 CURRENT before scaling out to the rest of the page.
representativeEcologyRule.failBehavior: Reject/regenerate the representative ecology only. Do not generate the rest of the page until style-family calibration passes.
representativeEcologyRule.passBehavior: Scale the accepted rendering language to the remaining page-specific ecologies/modules.

systemicHardRejects: flowchart/roadmap/PowerPoint visual grammar unless the Visual Master explicitly requires it
isolated micro-icon pile where one ecology should be authored
Visual Master crop or page screenshot used as active photo proxy
dominant saturated purple drift including #7e08f9 unless explicitly owner-approved

alphaPolicy.rule: Transparent outside is not sufficient. Verify intended interior opacity and edge anti-alias/fringe quality. A binary {0,255} alpha cutout on curved/organic raster art requires EDGE_ALPHA_QUALITY_REVIEW.

colorDriftRule.rule: Purple may not become a dominant route/fill/background color unless the owner explicitly approves it for that page.

hardProcessRule: Do not write a Codex production prompt before the current page manifest has been updated from the actual Visual Master review.
